# CityMoods

> Nightly maps of what New York City, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Boston complain about to 311 (the non-emergency city line), grouped into ten "moods" and mapped by neighborhood. Built from each city's official open data. Privacy-first: neighborhood totals only, counts under 3 never published, no addresses, names or written notes.

Data is free to use under CC BY 4.0. Please credit "CityMoods (citymoods311.com), from [city] 311 open data".

## Data

- [Data downloads page](https://citymoods311.com/data/): CSV files per city, updated nightly, with column definitions and methodology
- [Manifest (JSON)](https://citymoods311.com/data/downloads/manifest.json): every download file with URL, row count, sources and license
- [All cities, citywide by mood (CSV)](https://citymoods311.com/data/downloads/all-cities-citywide.csv): city, date, mood, requests, usual (same weekday, previous 4 weeks), weather
- All cities, every neighborhood by mood, one CSV per month: https://citymoods311.com/data/downloads/all-cities-neighborhoods-YYYY-MM.csv (and all-cities-neighborhood-types-YYYY-MM.csv for each neighborhood's top request types)
- [Data dictionary (CSV)](https://citymoods311.com/data/downloads/data-dictionary.csv): every column in every file, explained (also in manifest.json under "columns")
- Per-day JSON: https://citymoods311.com/data/<city>/days/YYYY-MM-DD.json (list of days: https://citymoods311.com/data/<city>/index.json). City keys: nyc, chicago, la, sf, boston

## Moods

No heat, Noise, Parking wars, Home repairs, Street fixes, Trash talk, Critters, Water & sewers, Trees, Everything else. Each city's mood-map.csv lists which raw 311 request types go into each mood.

## Site

- [Home](https://citymoods311.com/): the five cities' latest maps
- City maps: https://citymoods311.com/nyc/, /chicago/, /la/, /sf/, /boston/
- [Privacy](https://citymoods311.com/privacy.html): what is and isn't collected
